g.text: Treasury LTFS Figure 17 age profile; categories stacked
Age affects both the level and mix of health expenditure
Published age-cost profile: Published profile is used as a fixed weighting schedule, not current 2026 cost data. Underlying model weights
were updated in 2019. It does not control morbidity or proximity to death.
Sources: Treasury LTFS 2025 official figure data; LTFM and OLG identified separately
